faqs.q: Will it reply to customers without asking me?
faqs.a: No. Every reply waits in Needs you until you approve it, change it or decline it. AI agents ask before sending, even to you, until you allow otherwise in Settings. See [How to make an AI agent ask before it acts](/guides/how-to-make-an-ai-agent-ask-before-it-acts).

faqs.q: What does it do when it does not know the answer?
faqs.a: It drafts nothing for that email and lists it in its summary with what it needs to know. Add the answer to its instructions and the next run covers it.

faqs.q: Does it answer the moment an email arrives?
faqs.a: No. An AI agent runs on a schedule or when you ask it in its chat. For a reply drafted on each new email, ask Captain for an automation that starts on the Gmail new-email event.

faqs.q: Does it work with Zendesk, Help Scout or Intercom?
faqs.a: This one works with Gmail. If several people share a support queue, a help desk is the better tool for assignment and reporting.

faqs.q: How do I keep the replies sounding like me?
faqs.a: Tell Captain your tone and add a few of your own past replies as examples. You can also change any draft before approving it. [How to draft email replies with AI and still check them](/guides/how-to-draft-email-replies-with-ai-and-still-check-them) covers the one-minute review.
